role: Slime probe: EntitySlime and EntityMagmaCube of sizes 1, 2 and 4 spawned the SpawnerAnimals way in a flattened raw region (overworld and Nether) next to a concrete probe player, ticked in World.updateEntities order with splits, drops and damage events; records per-tick canonical-NBT FNV-1a hashes plus non-NBT state, the player's record, removals and the final blocks.
used_by: make -C oracle run CLASS=SlimeProbe (the generic {"cmd":"run","class":"SlimeProbe"} reflection dispatch in Oracle.java)
notes: Output manifest.json, shapes.bin, spawns.bin, ticks.bin.gz, events.txt.gz, digest.txt.gz, nbt64.txt.gz, spawns.txt.gz, removals.txt.gz, start.txt, end.txt, final.bin.gz. Declares the nested ProbePlayer (an EntityPlayer subclass) and its own canon(Entity). No oracle/src hook.
